item.title: Human mathematicians are being outcounterexampled
item.description:
📝 And indeed this was what Logical Intelligence had done: they had formalized precisely the statement that the profound theorem of number theory implied the Erdős counterexample. Breakthrough LLM-generated mathematics being formalized in real time. Boris made the code public and it did not take long for me to realise that somewhere within all this AI-generated (and sometimes horrible, although sometimes decent) code was indeed a proof of some really hard theorems in global class field theory.
🔗 Read more: https://xenaproject.wordpress.com/2026/07/20/human-mathematicians-are-being-outcounterexampled/

Firefox 153 available with support for Vulkan video decoding, JPEG-XL
item.description:
📝 Making Firefox 153 exciting is that it's the newest Extended Support Release "ESR" as well as introducing Vulkan Video decode support. On the feature side, Firefox 153 introduces Vulkan Video decoding support. Now with Firefox there is initial Vulkan Video decode support for that modern, cross-vendor and cross-platform video acceleration interface.
